claimSourcePairs.reason: The guide identifies non-sedimentation as representing a hiatus and defines a short interruption in deposition with little or no erosion.
The record links nondeposition to a significant gap in the geologic record, but defines unconformity rather than nondeposition itself.

stoppingCondition: Stop after two authoritative candidates per target claim have been independently reviewed; do not broaden the search in this task.
limitations: Candidate classifications are not adoption decisions.
A regional empirical example cannot alone establish a universal definition.
A terminology code can support concept meaning without validating the project's numerical implementation.
Nondeposition must remain distinct from erosion and from missing observational records.
